annotations.title: Toggle want to play or own

description: Toggle the authenticated user's want-to-play or want-to-own flag for a game. Calling twice turns the flag back off. Logging a play or marking the game owned will auto-clear the matching want flag server-side. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

wantType.description: 'play' toggles the want-to-play list; 'own' toggles the wishlist
